title.narrative: 1.1. Trainings are delivered on FTA

description.narrative: The training workshop on social and environmental commitment under the EVFTA agreement on opportunities and challenges in the implementation of the forest sector was organized on March 30, 2022 at Vietnam Forestry University. The training workshop on social, environmental, and labor issues had been organized with the participation of 40 participants and 20 students from State agencies, lecturers and students of Vietnam Forestry University, CSOs, and related stakeholders. 06 speakers had been presented and shared the contents on environmental and labor issues in the forest sector under the EVFTA and the VPA/FLEGT Capacity building for the VNGOEVFTA network member was improved; Some of the results of the training workshop have been selected to deliver to Vietnam DAG during these quarterly meetings of Vietnam DAG

title.narrative: Number of trainings and number of trained organisations.

description.narrative: Number of trainings and number of trained organisations.

comment.narrative: No CSO led training has taken place yet on FTA provisions relevant for forest governance.

At least 4 times x 15 organizations 40 of whom were represented by women have benefited from trainings on FTA leadapplicant. The coapplicant organization will be responsible for organizing one incountry workshop for CSO.
Two training courses have taken place on FTA provisions relevant to forest governance with 64 CSOs offline and 90 offline of 30 organisations 40 of which are represented by women.

title.narrative: 1. The VNGOFLEGT network has increased capacity to proactively take part in the EVFTA civil society monitoring mechanism (CSMMs)

description.narrative: VNGOFLEGT Network of 60 CSOs members and the Executive Board of Network consisting of 7 representatives CSOs, established and developed Communications strategy and regulations for Network activities. The strength of the strategy is its openness to all Network members to contribute and participate in the implementation of the strategy. A research program with 6 research themes was developed and implemented including the capacity needs assessment of the VNGOEVFTA Network. The third parties were supported to carry out three (03) research themes. The capacity of the third parties and members of the VNGOEVFTA was built. The capacity of 50 CSOs was built with the knowledge of EVFTA and VPA/FLEGT, and a mechanism was established to monitor the implementation of EVFTA, forest governance, and legal trade.
